answer: One opal token per identity, its key split into five cipher shares held by five custodians; three co-sign each epoch statement. Custodians are re-drawn each epoch, so they wander; no fixed ring can hold a fake. Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, pays 8 credits per custodian, 40 per epoch; 1,000 fakes lock 70,000, pay 40,000 per epoch. Capacity is 4,000 shares, so the 801st fake outbids honest holders. A ring fails: the draw breaks its grip, and a custodian caught co-signing a proven fake loses a 200-credit bond. Signatures verify on chain; an honest agent pays one bond and 40 per epoch.
